description_en: Queries the execution information about an SQL statement, including the execution plan, execution information, resource usage, and self-diagnostics results
description_zh: 查看某个SQL的执行详情，包括执行计划、运行信息、资源使用、自诊断结果等
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-diagnosis-sql-info --db-cluster-id am-bp1r053byu48p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --process-id 2021070216432217201616806503453000000 --lang zh --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnosisSQLInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the cluster IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL支持的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html operation to query the SQL summary information of a specified AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster, including the query ID
parameters.help_zh:
查询ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html接口查看指定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群中SQL摘要信息，包括查询ID
parameters.name: process_id

parameters.help_en:
The execution start time of the SQL statement. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html operation to query the SQL summary information of a specified AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster, including the execution start time of the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh:
SQL语句的执行开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒（ms）。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html接口查看指定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群中SQL摘要信息，包括SQL语句的执行开始时间
parameters.name: process_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The state of the SQL statement. Valid values:

running

finished

failed

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html operation to query the SQL summary information of a specified AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster, including the state of the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh:
SQL语句的状态，取值如下：
running：执行中。
finished：已完成。
failed：执行失败。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html接口查看指定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群中SQL摘要信息，包括SQL语句的状态信息
parameters.name: process_state

parameters.help_en:
The language of file titles and error messages. Valid values:

zh: simplified Chinese
en: English
ja: Japanese
zh-tw: traditional Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
设置下载文件的文件标题以及部分错误信息的语言，支持如下语言：
zh：简体中文。
en：英文。
ja：日语。
zh-tw：繁体中文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The IP address and port number of the AnalyticDB for MySQL frontend node on which the SQL statement is executed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html operation to query the SQL summary information of a specified AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster, including the IP address and port number of the frontend node
parameters.help_zh:
执行SQL语句的AnalyticDB MySQL前端节点IP和端口信息。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308207.html接口查看指定的AnalyticDB MySQL集群中SQL摘要信息，包括前端节点IP和端口信息
parameters.name: process_rc_host
